statement: For the density and separated centers constructed above, with the polynomial scale chosen sufficiently large, there are fixed constants c > 0, C < ∞ such that (I − P)Lc(I − P) ≥ c(I − P) on the complement, Lc ≥ −∆y/2 − C, ∥LcP∥ ≤ p(n, D)λ−0.9 . (6) The inequalities are quadratic-form inequalities on the one-particle H1 domain, and the last bound is an operator norm from the range of P to L2. All estimates hold with either spin included.
